messages.subject: Bootstrap and ggtree
parts:
Hello, I'm having trouble inserting bootstraps into the tree. Below are the codes used. Can anyone help me to solve this problem?

tree_nj <- nj(sm.final)
myBoots <- boot.phylo(tree_nj, dados2, function(xx) nj(dist(xx)), B = 1000)

##
setClass("apeBootstrap",
         representation = representation(
             phylo = "phylo",
             fields = "character",
             bootstrap = "data.frame",
             extraInfo = "data.frame"
         )
         )

apeBoot <- function(phylo, boot) {
    ## phylo is a phylo object
    ## boot is output from boot.phylo
    new("apeBootstrap",
        phylo=phylo,
        bootstrap=data.frame(node=(1:Nnode(phylo)) + Ntip(phylo), bootstrap=boot)
        )
}
##

tree_nj_V2 <- apeBoot(tree_nj, myBoots)

> ggtree(tree_nj_V2) + geom_label(aes(label=bootstrap)) + geom_tiplab()
Error: `data` must be a data frame, or other object coercible by `fortify()`, not an S4 object with class apeBootstrap

##
> str(tree_nj_V2)
